cases._comment: Combat Doctrines is the Codex army rule. The command-phase witness selects the doctrine, and the assault grant is scoped to the attested ranged weapon keyword; only Devastator is buff-bearing ([ASSAULT] on ranged weapons), so it surfaces as an opt-in lever in the stance's mutually-exclusive group. Assault (charge after Advancing) and Tactical (shoot and charge after Falling Back) grant move-then-act eligibility, which carries no buff.
